summary: Tested new Diet Planner feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_diet.py covering auth guards on GET/POST/DELETE /api/diet/plan, unsafe scenario (58->52kg/30d/ekstrem => direction=lose, safe=false, days_min_safe>=30, daily calories floored to >=1500 for male), GET returns saved plan, dashboard.targets switches to plan.daily_targets and dashboard.diet_plan populated, safe scenario (58->55kg/90d/santai => safe=true), and DELETE clears the plan. Frontend (mobile 390x844): demo login -> diet-cta on empty dashboard navigates to /diet, full form (input-target-weight, input-days slider, intensity-santai/ekstrem, meals-2/3/4/flex, budget-terjangkau/sedang/mahal, make-plan) all present. Submitting 52kg/30d/ekstrem shows diet-plan-view with unsafe-warn banner ('minimal 47 hari'), plan-menu (Sarapan/Makan Siang/Makan Malam), plan-exercises, plan-tips, and reset-plan. Home dashboard after plan shows diet-card ('Turun berat -> 52 kg, 30 hari, Ekstrem, 1500 kkal/hari'), calorie ring reflects 1500 target (330/1500 = 1170 sisa), today-meals list from seeded logs, and home-exercise card. reset-plan returns to editable form. Regression: bottom tabs (tab-home/mood/scan/history/profile) intact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~570-line module; consider splitting into routers (auth, foods, scan, mood, diet, logs) as it grows.
GET /api/diet/plan returns None (null) when no plan exists; Diet.jsx handles it, but a small {"plan": null} envelope would be more explicit.

compute_diet uses `days_min_safe = int(total_kcal / cap + 0.999)` which correctly ceilings; note that for very small deltas cap check still marks it safe even when days_min_safe would be 1 -- current logic is fine but worth a unit test.
Diet form input-days slider min=7 doesn't warn the user if they pick e.g. 7 days for a large delta -- backend already floors calories, which is good, and the unsafe-warn covers it.
Diet.jsx has no loading skeleton while GET /diet/plan is fetching on mount -- brief flash of the editable form is possible when a plan exists; minor UX only.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded demo user and its food logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diet Planner fully verified. test_diet.py deletes/re-creates the demo plan, so it's idempotent and safe to re-run. Previous suites (backend_test.py, test_mood.py) unchanged and remain valid. For UI, seed the JWT via localStorage.setItem('nv_token', <token>) then navigate to '/' to bypass login. The Gemini call for /api/diet/plan takes ~5-15s -- allow >=60s timeout for waiting on data-testid=diet-plan-view.
